main_text.p: Monachus floruit. Neftorius ad Epifcopatum, evectus, Mariam non dicendam Deiparam, as-Socrat. l. 9. 431ferunt, Ideo Concilium Ephefinum convocatum, cap. 29. & Neftorius ab Imperatore Epifcopatu dejectus Prosper. in Chron. eft. Tum Burgundiones & Scoti Chriftianifmum recepere. Sixtus III à Baffo quodam de ftupro 435Sacræ Virgini illato accufatus, à Valentiniano 434abfolutus eft. Sub eo Vincentius Lirinenfis con- tra Pelagianos & Neftorianos fcripfit. Theodo- 435fius libros Neftorii texuri juffit; eum in Oafim, relegavit. Alofes quidam in Creta, Judæos per Socrates l. 7. 432mare in Palæftinam reducere conatus eft: mul- cap. 36. tis fubmerfis, evanuit. Catenas Petri, & fafcias Nicephor. l. Servatoris inventas, fcribunt. Sub Leone intra, 14. c. 47. hoc tempus Eutychis error exortus, multum ne- Leo M. Epist. 19, 22, 85-86. gotii faceffivit. Is enim Concilii Conftantino- 448 politani primi judicium fubterfugit. Alterius 449facta falfavit*. In Ephefino anathema omnibus dictum, qui duas perfonas in Chrifto poft unio- nem ftatuerent; nec quicquam in Romano pro- fectum, eum Theodofius, à Chryfaphio Eunu- cho perfuafus, a partibus Eutychis ftaret. Ale- xandriæ conftituit primus omnium ftationes in Ecclefia Cyrilli major, Theophili antecefforis ex forore nepos; cujus etiam tempore I/aac, S. Ephrem Syri difcipulus, floruit. De cultu ignis apud PERSAS qui aliquid fcire volet, Benjaminem Tudelenfem confulat.

page.notes: Ornament at foot is a decorative mark, not text. Marginal line numbers (431–449) and side references are printed at the margins; the star (*) after "falfavit" is a printed mark. Several marginal references are small and partly uncertain; the left margin numbers were read approximately. Right-margin entries "Prosper. in Chron." and "Leo M. Epist." are as printed. Caput heading read from the foot of the page.
